detail_text: Action Code: Pre-solicitation Date: 27 February 2026 Year: Fiscal Year 2026 Contracting Office Zip Code: 23511 Product or Service Code: V124 - Transportation, Travel, & Relocation Services Contracting Office Address: 471 East C Street, Naval Station Norfolk, Norfolk, VA 23511 Subject: 30-day Special Time Charter Proposed Upcoming Solicitation Number: N3220526R6007 Solicitation Closing Response Date: Monday, 09 March 2026 Contract Point of Contact or Contract Specialist: Matthew Price at matthew.r.price40.civ@us.navy.mil; 564-230-3782 Contract Award and Solicitation Number: TBD Contract Award Dollar Amount: TBD Contract Line Item Number: N/A Contract Award Date: TBA Contractor: TBD Description: This requirement is for U.S. flagged, Jones Act, Offshore Supply Vessel (OSV) to support Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) Group Two/Mobile Dive And Salvage (MDS) diving operations and training exercises throughout the Gulf of Mexico, Key West, FLA, and Caribbean. Place of Contract Performance: The place/range of delivery and redelivery is NSA Panama City, Florida. The layday commences and cancels 27 April 2026, and the charter period is about 30 days for the charter. Set-aside Status: N/A. The decision to release this procurement as “Unrestricted” is based on responses received from a recent sources sought notice for this service. All responsible sources may submit a proposal, which shall be considered by the agency. The Small Business Administration Procurement Center Representative has concurred with this decision.
